scope: Natural care + dietary care protocols — veterinary module decision support

natural_care_pillars.name: Clean water always; oral fluids if mild dehydration
Reduce handling stress, crowding, predator exposure

principles: Stable rumen: adequate effective fibre before concentrates
Transition (3 weeks pre to 3 weeks post calving): energy and calcium programmes under vet/nutritionist
Mineral-vitamin mix matched to local deficiency maps
lactation_support_folklore: Fenugreek galactagogue folklore — traditional_only; fix mastitis/nutrition first

principles: Never untreated kitchen swill in ASF/CSF risk zones
Iron protocols for indoor piglets under vet guidance
Water ad libitum critical in heat
Browse + quality roughage; watch Haemonchus in wet seasons
Late pregnancy energy to prevent pregnancy toxaemia
Male/castrate: urinary stone risk with high concentrate — salt and water
Complete feed age-appropriate; avoid sudden changes
Heat: electrolytes, cool water, feed in cooler hours
Layer Ca continuity for shell quality
convalescent: Easy access to feed and water at low height if weak
